name: Keane Lucas
biography: Keane is a researcher on Anthropic's Frontier Red Team focused on stress-testing AI model cybersecurity capabilities. Before joining Anthropic, Keane served as a Cyberspace Operations Officer in the US Air Force and earned his PhD at Carnegie Mellon, where his research focused on applying machine learning to malware detection.
